name: FND_SAVED_SEARCH_USER_PREFS
description: Table to store the user customizations (preferences) for a particular saved search.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: USER_NAME - The user associated to the saved searches preferences

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH_ID
columns.description: SAVED_SEARCH_ID - unique id for saved search

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: ENABLED_FLAG - Is this saved search enabled (Y/N).  Only enabled saved searches will be seen by the end-user.

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: VISIBLE_FLAG - Is the Saved Search shown in UI to users?

columns.name: AUTO_RUN_FLAG
columns.description: AUTO_RUN_FLAG - Is the Saved Search automatically executed?  Some saved searches should not be run blind and require users to provide keywords before execution.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
